newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor falls on sluggish export interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor falls on sluggish export interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery on Thursday fell to 1,135/1,136 rupees from 1,142/1,143 rupees on renewed speculative offerings, dealers said.
"Sluggish export demand and reports of rising new crop arrivals at the producing centres triggered fresh speculative selling particulary by bear operators," one dealer.

"South Indian arrivals remained low yesterday but picked up again today," he said. Foreign buyers are seeking Indian castoroil at $660 per tonne while Indian offers are at $675. Groundnut oil slid to 346/347 rupees per 10 kg on limited demand coupled with fresh new crop arrivals of about 100/120 tonnes.
In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 530 rupees per 15 kg.
